title: Exclusion buffer value after Phase 1 (registered rule) and Iburi exclusion layers
basis: Polygon areas and counts only (phase1_iburi_extent_counts.json; v01 Amendment 1 buffer_derivation). No v02 sample, no v02 terrain block, no terrain value of Iburi, no model. Existing v02 outputs are the PGA feature and the predictions of the registered Gorkha sensitivity on read-only v01 samples; they do not depend on the buffer.

registry.datasets.iburi_2018.exclusion_l.value: GSI slope-failure/deposit polygons (all 3,307 incl. the deviating-style feature) and Zenodo old_landslides.shp (1,649; the 110 reactivated_landslides all intersect it), buffered by exclusion_buffer_m; GSI cloud-obscured polygons (10) unbuffered. Positives: 3,177 GSI main-style polygons that do not intersect old_landslides.shp (129 do and are exclusion only).
registry.datasets.iburi_2018.exclusion_l.reason: Makes the registered exclusion_geometry rule concrete for the GSI-based Iburi inventory (Amendment 1).

registry.datasets.iburi_2018.old_landsli.value: The Zenodo old-landslide mapping has no extent. Its bounding box leaves 253.1 km2 (18.6 %) of the GSI extent uncovered, where 2 of 3306 GSI polygons lie; there the old-landslide rule cannot act and background is not excluded from unmapped old scars. Inside the box, coverage is assumed, not proven. The registered rule is kept; no extent or positive is changed because of this.
registry.datasets.iburi_2018.old_landsli.reason: Documents a limitation found in Phase 1 before any sample.

buffer_derivation.rule: max over the v02 development inventories of the 90th percentile of sqrt(area/pi) of valid positive polygons, rounded up to 10 m, floor 60 m, cap 300 m

sources.gorkha_2015: v01 Amendment 1 buffer_derivation (identical positive definition: Source20170209.shp)

buffer_derivation.rer2023: pending_extent, not a development inventory; v01 Phase 1 gave a provisional p90 of 26.1 m over all its polygons, below this value, so promoting it later would not raise the maximum; to be confirmed by the amendment that promotes it

phase1_gate: earthquake arm met: gorkha_2015 and iburi_2018 have licences recorded at the original and independent extents; ShakeMap grid.xml for both events covers the whole extent (Gorkha 132/132, Iburi 1,802/1,802 extent vertices). Rain arm not met (rer2023 pending_extent); it is not modelled and not replaced.
preconditions: registration present; nothing from stage 'samples' on existed
